text:
maya: Heads-up — support case INC-8342. Customer reports a EUR bank transfer that our auto-recon failed to match. Amount lines up with invoice 4921 but the remittance field is truncated to 'INV-4921/AC' and there's no PO or payer legal name. Any quick ideas?

oliver: Can you get the raw MT103 or the bank remittance advice? Intermediary banks often truncate tag 70. Screenshot rarely helps.

maya: They uploaded a low-res PDF to the portal. Asked them to attach the MT103 (they said they'd request it from their bank). In the meantime — amount is EUR 12,400.00, value date 2025-11-28.

sam_k: If we don't have MT103, treasury can match by exact amount+value date+currency. DM me the amount/date and I'll kick off a ledger search. Also, do we have beneficiary account last digits?

maya: Pushed details in #secure-files and pinged finance_ops_bot with the case link. Beneficiary IBAN ends with 3421 (we only log last 4 currently).

finance_ops_bot: File uploaded: mt103_4921_lowres.pdf (restricted). Suggested command: ```/recon-search --amount 12400 --date 2025-11-28 --currency EUR --iban-tail 3421```

oliver: FYI — I ran a quick search. Often tag 70 (remittance information) is cut to ~16 chars by intermediaries. Treasury, can you pull candidate inbound tx for that date/amount/iban-tail?

Finance Ops: Search results — 3 hits on 2025-11-28: tx-5231 (EUR 12,400 — no remittance), tx-5232 (EUR 12,400 — remittance 'INV-4921/ACME' truncated), tx-5233 (EUR 12,400 — remittance 'PAYMENT REF' but different ordering bank). Only tx-5232 has a partial invoice ref and payer name 'ACME S.A.' in the MT103.

maya: Customer insists payer legal name is 'Acme Software GmbH' (their AP uses a trading name). Could that mapping be acceptable? They also claim their bank shows full ref 'PO 773-INV-4921' in their online history.

sam_k: For amounts >€10k we require either PO or MT103 to apply payment. If the MT103 from their bank shows the PO, that's fine. Otherwise, we need a signed remittance or a SWIFT trace. Recommend requesting the full MT103 + ordering bank BIC + message id, then open a trace.

oliver: I'll open a SWIFT trace with banking partner and cc @banksupport. We shouldn't auto-apply without provenance, but we can put a provisional hold on invoice 4921 (flag: pending-provenance).

finance_ops_bot: Trace ticket created: TR-9876. ETA 48-72 hours for reply from intermediary banks.

maya: Customer sent back a low-res MT103 scan — I requested the original PDF or the bank's SWIFT copy. Also asked them to confirm ordering IBAN and payment reference exactly as their bank shows it.

sam_k: Also ask customer for the ordering bank's message id and sender-to-receiver info. That shortens the trace time.

oliver: Follow-up — if trace confirms the PO/INV in tag 70, we backdate and clear invoice 4921. If trace fails, per policy we hold funds until provenance is proven or initiate refunds per treasury guidance.

maya: Acknowledged. Updating INC-8342 with the trace ticket and the request for high-res MT103. Will ping again when we have the SWIFT copy. :thumbsup:

banksupport: Noted and standing by for SWIFT trace escalation. Please include any MT199/MT103 headers in the ticket.
